name: pi-web-enhanced
description: Web search, URL fetching, GitHub repo cloning, and local PDF extraction for Pi coding agent. Supports Exa, Tavily, AnySearch, TinyFish, SerpApi, Firecrawl, Brave, Querit, and DuckDuckGo, with weighted-provider balanced search and all-provider enhanced sea
